changelog: Outlook / Microsoft 365 is now two-way — events you create sync back to your Outlook calendar (reconnect once to grant write). Smarter memory — 'remember' now skips near-duplicates and warns when a new fact contradicts one you already told it, so you can replace it. More one-click connectors — official hosted Linear and Jira/Confluence servers that sign in through your browser (no token to paste), plus an 'any remote MCP' option.
